methodology: The study involved the modification of aerated concrete with various additives and fibers, including flyash, ground granulated blast-furnace slag, coconutfiber, and coconut fiber. The compositions were tested for their impact on compressive strength (CS), bending strength (BS), coefficient of construction quality (CCQ), density, and thermal conductivity.
research_objective: To identify rational combinations of recipe-technological factors for simultaneous modification of aerated concrete with various additives and reinforcement with different types of plant fibers.

Coconut fibers can be used as a reinforcing component in concrete, replacing synthetic fibers like polypropylene fibers.
